compliance.summary: The article is largely a general comparison, but its GoGloby section and banner present an obsolete consulting, diagnosis, and AI tooling offer rather than GoGloby’s recruiting and staffing services. The author bio also contains unsupported or conflicting claims that need correction.

llm_problems.title: GoGloby positioned as consulting provider
llm_problems.rule: Fact Sheet: Identity and Services; Glossary §2
llm_problems.issue: The page presents GoGloby as diagnosing engineering systems and delivering fixes, rather than as a staffing and recruiting agency specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers.
llm_problems.fix: Replace the GoGloby-specific positioning with an accurate description of its recruiting and staffing services.

llm_problems.source_value: Staffing and recruiting agency specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers

llm.evidence: The provider invoice is only one part of the total cost. Internal engineering time, onboarding, rework, and coordination also require engineering time, so a lower quoted rate does not by itself show a lower total cost.
llm.note: The article discusses generic engagement costs but does not compare hiring through GoGloby with the cost and wait of an open full-time US role.
